# Edgible cards

> Self-hosted apps to run on a machine you control (at home, in the office, or a small cloud server), published through Edgible. Each card records the images, ports, and auth mode of each hostname, and is tested end to end on a real Edgible serving device.

Why cards exist, and why they are shaped for sharing: https://cards.edgible.org/about/
How to use cards with an AI agent, and the skill to install: https://cards.edgible.org/ai/
How to run a card on your own server without Edgible: https://cards.edgible.org/run-without-edgible/
AI Playbooks, step-by-step guides your AI assistant follows, each chapter also as Markdown (add .md to its name): https://cards.edgible.org/playbooks/
Where apps for cards are found, and what an app needs to become one: https://cards.edgible.org/sources/

Each card page has how to start, publish, check, and remove the card. Each need page says whether self-hosting suits that need, which questions decide it, and how to publish it safely. The source of every card is https://github.com/edgible-org/cards. An AI agent can do the whole flow with the edgible-cards skill: https://github.com/edgible-org/card-kit/tree/main/skills/edgible-cards

## App cards

- [activepieces](https://cards.edgible.org/activepieces/): Activepieces automation, the editor behind org and the webhook hostname open. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [arize-phoenix](https://cards.edgible.org/arize-phoenix/): Arize Phoenix, LLM traces and evals in one container, the dashboard behind org and the trace ingestion behind an api-key. Test passed 2026-11-09 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [bloglite](https://cards.edgible.org/bloglite/): bloglite, a micro-blog with Markdown, syntax highlighting and phone publishing, public with the owner's own login. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [canary](https://cards.edgible.org/canary/): A smoke test for Edgible, one tiny container that answers on every auth mode. Test passed 2026-10-27 on Edgible 1.4.12.
- [chatwoot](https://cards.edgible.org/chatwoot/): Chatwoot, a support inbox with a website chat widget and bots for chat apps, with sign-up closed. Test passed 2026-11-07 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [club-noticeboard](https://cards.edgible.org/club-noticeboard/): Club noticeboard, notices members read without an account, posted by a committee with its own password. Test passed 2026-11-05 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [docmost](https://cards.edgible.org/docmost/): Docmost, a collaborative team wiki and Notion or Confluence alternative, behind your org login. Test passed 2026-11-08 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [domoticz](https://cards.edgible.org/domoticz/): Domoticz, a home automation hub for lights, switches and sensors, kept on your own machine, with a web interface and phone apps. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [ech0](https://cards.edgible.org/ech0/): Ech0, a lightweight publishing platform for short posts, public with the owner's own login. Test passed 2026-11-12 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [edgible-mcp](https://cards.edgible.org/edgible-mcp/): Edgible tools for Claude and other assistants, read-only unless you allow writes. Test failed 2026-11-13 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [freshrss](https://cards.edgible.org/freshrss/): FreshRSS, a self-hosted feed reader, behind your org login on the web and its own login for phone apps. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [frigate](https://cards.edgible.org/frigate/): Frigate, a security camera recorder that finds people and cars on your own machine, behind your org login. Test passed 2026-11-08 on Edgible 1.4.29.

- [grafana-mcp](https://cards.edgible.org/grafana-mcp/): Grafana's MCP server, so your AI assistants can read your dashboards and metrics, behind a key per person. Test passed 2026-11-07 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [hedgedoc](https://cards.edgible.org/hedgedoc/): HedgeDoc, realtime collaborative markdown notes, behind your org login. Test passed 2026-11-13 on Edgible 1.4.29.

- [home-assistant](https://cards.edgible.org/home-assistant/): Home Assistant, one app for all your smart devices, with automations that keep running without the cloud, kept on your own machine, with a web interface and phone apps. Test passed 2026-11-13 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [immich](https://cards.edgible.org/immich/): Immich, your photo and video library, for its phone apps and the web. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [jellyfin](https://cards.edgible.org/jellyfin/): Jellyfin, your films, shows and music, streamed to its apps and the web. Test passed 2026-11-07 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [keeper-sh](https://cards.edgible.org/keeper-sh/): Keeper.sh, which syncs calendars between iCal feeds, CalDAV and other sources without Google in the middle, on its own login. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [langflow](https://cards.edgible.org/langflow/): Langflow's builder behind org, each flow's API behind a key, and a webhook hostname open. Test passed 2026-11-07 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [leafwiki](https://cards.edgible.org/leafwiki/): LeafWiki, a fast Markdown wiki with a page tree, for a team, behind your org login. Test passed 2026-11-05 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [linkding](https://cards.edgible.org/linkding/): linkding, a minimal bookmark manager, for your browsers and its extension. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [linkwarden](https://cards.edgible.org/linkwarden/): Linkwarden, a bookmark manager that saves a copy of each page, behind its own login. Test passed 2026-11-12 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [litellm](https://cards.edgible.org/litellm/): An AI gateway for your apps, one address for every model, with a key and a budget per app. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [localai](https://cards.edgible.org/localai/): LocalAI, an OpenAI-compatible server for language, image and audio models on your own machine, its API on a key and its web UI behind org. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [mcp-bridge](https://cards.edgible.org/mcp-bridge/): Any stdio MCP server, published over Streamable HTTP for your AI assistants. Test passed 2026-11-08 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [mcp-signin](https://cards.edgible.org/mcp-signin/): Sign in with Edgible in front of any MCP server, so Claude on the web and phone can use it. Test passed 2026-11-13 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [mediamtx](https://cards.edgible.org/mediamtx/): MediaMTX, a live media server for cameras and streams, watched in a browser over HLS. Test passed 2026-11-07 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [memos](https://cards.edgible.org/memos/): Memos, a private note-taking app on a SQLite file, for the web and its phone apps. Test passed 2026-11-11 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [minecraft](https://cards.edgible.org/minecraft/): A Minecraft server for friends on PC over TCP and on phones over UDP, one world. Test passed 2026-11-12 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [miniflux](https://cards.edgible.org/miniflux/): Miniflux, the minimalist feed reader, behind your org login. Test passed 2026-11-02 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [notediscovery](https://cards.edgible.org/notediscovery/): NoteDiscovery, a searchable Markdown library of your team's know-how, for people behind org login and AI assistants on an API key. Test passed 2026-11-05 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [ntfy](https://cards.edgible.org/ntfy/): ntfy, push notifications to your phone from your own scripts, on its own logins. Test passed 2026-11-08 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [ollama-nvidia](https://cards.edgible.org/ollama-nvidia/): Ollama on a Linux machine's NVIDIA GPU, in Docker, as an API behind a key. Not tested yet.
- [ollama-osx](https://cards.edgible.org/ollama-osx/): Ollama on an Apple Silicon Mac, natively on its GPU, as an API behind a key. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [onedev](https://cards.edgible.org/onedev/): OneDev, your own Git forge with code review, issues and CI/CD, with Git over HTTPS and SSH. Test passed 2026-11-13 on Edgible 1.4.29.

## Pattern cards

- [accounts](https://cards.edgible.org/accounts/): Sign-up and sign-in for your visitors, and the console that manages them. Not tested yet.
- [assistant](https://cards.edgible.org/assistant/): Chat that answers from your own documents, and the model that runs it. Not tested yet.
- [ci](https://cards.edgible.org/ci/): Your own Git forge with CI, and the runner on a machine of its own. Test passed 2026-11-13 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [edgible-agent](https://cards.edgible.org/edgible-agent/): Your own AI agent that looks after your Edgible apps, from your phone. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [edgible-connector](https://cards.edgible.org/edgible-connector/): Edgible in Claude's web, desktop and phone apps, signed in with Edgible. Test passed 2026-11-13 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [n8n](https://cards.edgible.org/n8n/): n8n with its editor behind org and a webhook hostname open to the services that call it. Test passed 2026-11-06 on Edgible 1.4.29.
- [website](https://cards.edgible.org/website/): Public React site, its editor, open tracker, locked dashboard, locked monitor. Not tested yet.

## Needs

- [Bookmarks and Link Sharing](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/bookmarks-and-link-sharing/): Good fit. Replaces Pocket, Raindrop.io, Instapaper, Pinboard, Omnivore. Cards: linkding, linkwarden.
- [Photo Galleries](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/photo-galleries/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Google Photos, iCloud Photos, Amazon Photos, Flickr. Cards: immich, photoprism.
- [File Transfer & Synchronization](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/file-transfer-synchronization/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, iCloud Drive. Cards: owncloud, sync-in.
- [Password Managers](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/password-managers/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces 1Password, LastPass, Bitwarden cloud, Dashlane. Cards: vaultwarden, passbolt.
- [Booking and Scheduling](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/booking-and-scheduling/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces court booking apps, Calendly, Doodle, Google Calendar booking pages. Cards: rallly, hi-events, seatsurfing.
- [Analytics](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/analytics/): Good fit. Replaces Google Analytics, Plausible cloud, Fathom, Simple Analytics. Cards: umami, website, rybbit.
- [Content Management Systems (CMS)](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/content-management-systems-cms/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Squarespace, Wix, WordPress.com, managed WordPress hosting. Cards: wordpress, website, accounts, redaxo.
- [Blogging Platforms](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/blogging-platforms/): Good fit. Replaces Substack, Medium, Ghost(Pro), Beehiiv. Cards: bloglite, ech0.
- [Static Site Generators](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/static-site-generators/): Usually better elsewhere. Replaces Squarespace, Wix, GitHub Pages. Cards: static-site, website.
- [Federated Identity & Authentication](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/federated-identity-authentication/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Auth0, Clerk, AWS Cognito, Firebase Auth. Cards: accounts.
- [Wikis](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/wikis/): Good fit. Replaces Notion, Confluence, Slab, GitBook. Cards: docmost, wiki-go, xwiki, leafwiki, otter-wiki, wiki-js.
- [Knowledge Management Tools](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/knowledge-management-tools/): Good fit. Replaces Guru, Notion, Confluence, SharePoint, legal and professional knowledge platforms. Cards: assistant, notediscovery.
- [Note-taking & Editors](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/note-taking-editors/): Good fit. Replaces Evernote, Notion, Google Keep, OneNote. Cards: memos.
- [Document Management](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/document-management/): Good fit. Replaces Evernote scanning, Adobe Acrobat online, online PDF tools. Cards: stirling-pdf, paperless-ngx.
- [Feed Readers](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/feed-readers/): Good fit. Replaces Feedly, Inoreader, NewsBlur. Cards: miniflux, freshrss.
- [Media Streaming - Multimedia Streaming](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/media-streaming-multimedia-streaming/): Good fit. Replaces Plex Pass, Netflix for owned media, iTunes Match. Cards: jellyfin, mediamtx.
- [Internet of Things (IoT)](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/internet-of-things-iot/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces SmartThings, Google Home, Alexa routines, vendor cloud apps. Cards: domoticz, home-assistant.
- [Video Surveillance](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/video-surveillance/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Ring Protect, Nest Aware, Arlo Secure. Cards: frigate.
- [Automation](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/automation/): Good fit. Replaces Zapier, Make, IFTTT. Cards: n8n, activepieces.
- [Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI)](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/generative-artificial-intelligence-genai/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces ChatGPT, Claude.ai for private documents, hosted LLM APIs. Cards: assistant, litellm, ollama-osx, open-webui.
- [AI tools for assistants (MCP servers)](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/ai-tools-for-assistants-mcp-servers/): Good fit. Replaces hosted MCP platforms, Zapier MCP, keeping the server on one laptop. Cards: mcp-signin, mcp-bridge, edgible-mcp, grafana-mcp.
- [Notifications](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/notifications/): Good fit. Replaces Pushover, Pushbullet, IFTTT notifications. Cards: ntfy.
- [Vector databases and AI search](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/vector-databases-and-ai-search/): Good fit. Replaces Pinecone, Weaviate Cloud, Zilliz Cloud, Qdrant Cloud. Cards: qdrant.
- [AI chatbots for customers and communities](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/ai-chatbots-for-customers-and-communities/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Intercom Fin, Chatbase, Tidio, Botpress Cloud, Voiceflow. Cards: n8n, chatwoot.
- [AI app builders and agents](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/ai-app-builders-and-agents/): Good fit. Replaces OpenAI GPTs and Assistants, Relevance AI, Stack AI, LangChain hosted tools, hosted agent services, an agent left running on a laptop. Cards: openclaw, n8n, litellm, langflow.
- [LLM observability and evaluation](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/llm-observability-and-evaluation/): Good fit. Replaces LangSmith, Helicone, Braintrust, Weights & Biases Weave. Cards: arize-phoenix.
- [Image, audio, and speech AI](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/image-audio-and-speech-ai/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Midjourney, Otter.ai, ElevenLabs, Descript transcription. Cards: speaches.
- [Experimental AI for early adopters](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/experimental-ai-for-early-adopters/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces hosted coding agents, hosted model APIs, being on a waitlist. Cards: localai.
- [Software Development - Project Management](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/software-development-project-management/): Good fit. Replaces GitHub, GitLab.com, Bitbucket. Cards: gitea, ci, onedev.
- [Software Development - Continuous Integration & Deployment](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/software-development-continuous-integration-deployment/): Good fit. Replaces GitHub Actions minutes, CircleCI, GitLab CI minutes. Cards: ci.
- [Monitoring & Status Pages](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/monitoring-status-pages/): Good fit. Replaces UptimeRobot, Pingdom, Statuspage, Better Uptime. Cards: uptime-kuma, website.
- [Calendar & Contacts](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/calendar-contacts/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Google Calendar, iCloud Calendar, Google Contacts. Cards: keeper-sh.
- [Games](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/games/): Fits, with conditions. Replaces Minecraft Realms, rented game servers. Cards: minecraft, razzia.
- [Communication - Email - Complete Solutions](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/communication-email-complete-solutions/): Usually better elsewhere. Replaces Gmail, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Fastmail. No card yet.
- [DNS](https://cards.edgible.org/needs/dns/): Not recommended. Replaces NextDNS, ad-blocking DNS services. No card yet.
